snippet.title: Match & Mastery | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Frosty Games Fest is proud to announce Match & Mastery – a turn-based tactics game with a Match-3 twist! Master your magic, unleash powerful spells, and face challenging foes to free the land from a deadly magical blight in this unique genre mash-up where lining up gems is the key to moving and attacking in a procedurally generated experience. 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189890/Match__Mastery/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
